about: What config.xbr's cells hold, by the file's own table and row names (settings_foo: each setting's column name): each cell's label, type (number, int32: a number the game reads as a 32-bit integer, text, list: words), unit, range (a hint, never a limit), value set and note. Ported from Modkit's schema.json (its entries checked against the game).

armor_hit_fx.about: The effect a hit of each damage record on each armor plays.

armor_properties.about: Armor table (15×19 grid), loaded by 0x3C700 as config/armor_properties — edit here for effects that show up in-game (e.g. Flaps per air shield).

Type.label: Type
Type.note: The armor's 4-letter type code; a magic armor spell's Armor names it.

Strong vs.label: Strong vs Damage Type
Strong vs.note: Up to 2 damage type codes whose hits use Strong protection and Strong protection hp (0x83FE0); a third fails the game's MAX_VS_COUNT assert (0x3C905).

Weak vs.label: Weak vs Damage Type
Weak vs.note: Up to 2 damage type codes whose hit breaks the armor at once, unreduced (0x83FE0); a third fails the game's MAX_VS_COUNT assert (0x3CA24).

Strong protection.label: Strong Protection Mult
Strong protection.note: Fraction of a hit absorbed when its type is in Strong vs: round(base x this), at most Strong protection hp (0x83FE0).

Normal protection.label: Normal Protection Mult
Normal protection.note: Fraction of a hit absorbed when its type is in neither list: round(base x this), at most Normal protection hp (0x83FE0).

Strong protection hp.label: Strong Prot HP Cap
Strong protection hp.note: Most HP the armor absorbs from one hit of a Strong vs type (truncated to int32, 0xF5A40).

Normal protection hp.label: Normal Prot HP Cap
Normal protection hp.note: Most HP the armor absorbs from one hit of any other type (truncated to int32, 0xF5A40).

Cost.label: Fuel Cost
Cost.note: Fuel per element to cast this armor (truncated to int32, 0xF5A40); not a price.

Hits.label: Hits
Hits.note: Total the armor absorbs before it breaks (truncated to int32, 0xF5A40).

Time.label: Time
Time.note: Seconds the armor lasts (vanilla: the light armors' 5, 10 and 20).

Flaps.label: Flap Count
Flaps.note: Wing flaps the air shield grants (truncated to int32, 0xF5A40); the Air Shield flaps sliders set it.

Features.label: Features
Features.note: The armor's features (vanilla: light on the light armors). Feature names, any number, space-separated: the game ORs them into one mask (0x50D80), and a word it doesn't know sets bit 0x80000000.

attacks_anims.about: One column per attack move, the player's and the critters': the animation window and root-motion frames it plays, their rate, its aim, and the multipliers on its damage record's damage and fuel (empty = 1).

Damage multiplier.label: Damage Multiplier
Damage multiplier.note: Scales the hit's base damage against a critter (rounded up); empty = 1.0. Hits on the player ignore it.

Fuel multiplier.label: Fuel Multiplier
Fuel multiplier.note: Scales the fuel each hit takes from each element of the spell (rounded up); empty = 1.0.

Aim angle.label: Aim Angle
Aim angle.note: Empty: the move doesn't aim (the loader's sentinel 100000, 0x7F202); what a value does isn't traced.

attacks_transitions.about: Which attack follows which: each column a transition (38), read in order.

search order.label: Search Order
search order.note: Unused: the game never reads it (no 'search order' string in the XBE).

last move.label: Last Move
last move.note: The move this transition follows: an attack (attacks_anims), or run, jump or jump attack.

button.label: Button
button.note: The attack button, 1, 2 or 3; empty: any.

touch.label: Touch
touch.note: light or heavy; empty in every vanilla transition.

target direction.label: Target Direction
target direction.note: forward, back, left, right, up, down or any; whether it is the stick's direction or the target's bearing isn't traced.

target features.label: Target Features
target features.note: The target's features (vanilla: stunned, frozen). Feature names, any number, space-separated: the game ORs them into one mask (0x50D80), and a word it doesn't know sets bit 0x80000000.

critters_critter_data.about: One column per critter or pickup: its run and walk-threshold speeds and their animation rates, attack reach, drowning and corpse timers, pain thresholds and knockbacks, bound and collision radii, five drop slots, the features it fears, follows, attacks and eats, its ranges, sound distances and spawn limits.

noFreeze.label: No Freeze
noFreeze.note: Yes/no: the game keeps whether it isn't 0 (0x49E9A); empty reads 0. By its name the critter can't be frozen; where the game uses it isn't traced.

hitsThroughWalls.label: Hits Through Walls
hitsThroughWalls.note: Yes/no: the game keeps whether it isn't 0 (0x49EE2); empty reads 0. By its name the critter's attacks pass through walls; where the game uses it isn't traced.

drop1.label: Drop Item 1
drop1.note: What drop slot 1 names: a pickup (critters_item_data), or a critter (flicken of peril names itself).

drop2.label: Drop Item 2
drop2.note: What drop slot 2 names: a pickup (critters_item_data), or a critter (flicken of peril names itself).

drop3.label: Drop Item 3
drop3.note: What drop slot 3 names: a pickup (critters_item_data), or a critter (flicken of peril names itself).

drop4.note: What drop slot 4 names: a pickup (critters_item_data), or a critter (flicken of peril names itself).

drop5.label: Drop Item 5
drop5.note: What drop slot 5 names: a pickup (critters_item_data), or a critter (flicken of peril names itself).

f.fear.label: Fear Range Tag
f.fear.note: The features of what this critter fears, by its name. Feature names, any number, space-separated: the game ORs them into one mask (0x50D80), and a word it doesn't know sets bit 0x80000000.

f.follow.label: Follow Target Tag
f.follow.note: The features of what this critter follows, by its name. Feature names, any number, space-separated: the game ORs them into one mask (0x50D80), and a word it doesn't know sets bit 0x80000000.

f.attack.label: Attack Target Tag
f.attack.note: The features of what this critter attacks, by its name. Feature names, any number, space-separated: the game ORs them into one mask (0x50D80), and a word it doesn't know sets bit 0x80000000.

f.food.label: Food Target Tag
f.food.note: The features of what this critter eats, by its name. Feature names, any number, space-separated: the game ORs them into one mask (0x50D80), and a word it doesn't know sets bit 0x80000000.

critters_damage.about: Per-entity HP, the damage record its attacks deal, and the HP each damage record takes from it (absolute HP, not multipliers).

damageType.label: Damage Type
damageType.note: The damage record this critter's attacks deal, by name (one of damage's records; norm_1 for the player and 28 critters).

hitPoints.label: Hit Points
hitPoints.note: Hit points of a critter of this species (truncated to int32, 0xF5A40). Critter init uses it when a spawn passes a negative HP: level critters from critterGenerators do, the player doesn't (its HP is settings_foo 'initial hp'). Verified statically, not seen in game.

critters_engine.about: Per-entity engine settings: body, AI, realm, size and features (184 entities: 108 critters, 73 pickups, 3 others).

realm.label: Realm
realm.note: The critter's realm features (earth, water, air, fire, death, life). Feature names, any number, space-separated: the game ORs them into one mask (0x50D80), and a word it doesn't know sets bit 0x80000000.

size.label: Size
size.note: The critter's size features (tiny, small, normal, large, huge). Feature names, any number, space-separated: the game ORs them into one mask (0x50D80), and a word it doesn't know sets bit 0x80000000.

other features.label: Other Features
other features.note: Feature names, any number, space-separated: the game ORs them into one mask (0x50D80), and a word it doesn't know sets bit 0x80000000.

ai.label: AI
ai.note: The entity's AI by name: one of the 20 vanilla ones (item, walk, town, flocking, herd, player, a boss's own …).

invType.label: Inventory Type
invType.note: The pickup's inventory type code: one of the 58 vanilla ones (gems, fuels, keys, powers …).

damage.about: One column per damage record (norm_1 to drown), which a spell or the plain staff finds by Type and Level: the HP a hit deals, its delay, the fuel it costs and the freeze it applies.

Level.label: Damage Level
Level.note: The record's level: a spell or the plain staff finds its record by Type and Level, the first that matches (0x46A30); truncated to int32 (0x46730).

Damage.label: Base Damage
Damage.note: HP a hit deals, unless the critter hit has its own cell for the record in critters_damage; times the move's Damage multiplier against a critter (rounded up). Truncated to int32 (0x46730).

Cost.label: Fuel Cost
Cost.note: Fuel a hit takes from each element of the spell, times the move's Fuel multiplier (rounded up); truncated to int32 (0x46730).

magic.about: One column per spell, named by its elements (E, A, F, W; none for the plain staff): a staff or an armor spell, the damage type or the armor it casts, and whether it fires one attack by itself.

Damage.label: Magic Damage
Damage.note: The damage type a staff spell deals, a 4-letter code (only its first 4 characters count) at the level of the spell's lowest element, held to 1-3; empty on armor spells.

Sequence.label: Elements
Sequence.note: The spell's elements as letters (E earth, A air, F fire, W water), as the column's name; none for the plain staff.

Auto.label: Auto-Activate
Auto.note: One-shot: yes (any nonzero; empty reads 0) makes casting fire one attack by itself, then the staff reverts to plain.

Type.label: Spell Kind
Type.note: staff (a staff spell) or armor (an armor spell).

Armor.label: Armor Cast
Armor.note: The armor an armor spell casts, by armor_properties' Type code; empty on staff spells.

settings_foo.about: Global settings, one column per setting (the column's Key cell is its name), row 'Value'; the game looks each one up by name (0x5E620). Starting fuel and HP, fuel-cap upgrades, the HUD HP scale and fall damage.
settings_foo.notes: One value per setting, not one per element: a new game reads a single 'initial fuel' and 'initial fuel cap' (0x57B70; HP research 2026-10-09). Each column is three 16-byte cells (Key, Value, an empty third row). The keys below are labels; each entry's live_name is config.xbr's own column name ('initial hp').

initial fuel.label: Initial Fuel
initial fuel.note: Starting fuel: a new game and every continue set the four element fuels to it (0x52F50).

initial fuel cap.label: Initial Fuel Cap
initial fuel cap.note: Starting maximum fuel capacity at a new game (0x57B70).

fuel cap inc.label: Fuel Cap Increment
fuel cap inc.note: Fuel capacity added per upgrade; how an upgrade is earned, and for which element, is unverified.

num fuel inc.label: Num Fuel Increments
num fuel inc.note: How many fuel capacity upgrades there are in all.

fuel inc gems.label: Fuel Inc Gem Cost
fuel inc gems.note: Gems per fuel capacity upgrade; which gem raises which element is unverified.

initial hp.label: Initial HP
initial hp.note: Player HP at a new game, current and max; every continue resets current HP to it. Each power_life adds its invAmount (40) to both, uncapped.

max hp.label: Max HP
max hp.note: The health bar's full scale, read only by the HUD: the bar is max HP / this long and filled to HP / this. Not a cap.

lev 2 obs.label: Level 2 Obstacle Goal
lev 2 obs.note: Unused: the game never reads this setting (no name for it in the XBE).

lev 2 hp.label: Level 2 HP Bonus
lev 2 hp.note: Unused: the game never reads this setting (no name for it in the XBE).

lev 3 obs.label: Level 3 Obstacle Goal
lev 3 obs.note: Unused: the game never reads this setting (no name for it in the XBE).

lev 3 hp.label: Level 3 HP Bonus
lev 3 hp.note: Unused: the game never reads this setting (no name for it in the XBE).

lev 4 obs.label: Level 4 Obstacle Goal
lev 4 obs.note: Unused: the game never reads this setting (no name for it in the XBE).

lev 4 hp.label: Level 4 HP Bonus
lev 4 hp.note: Unused: the game never reads this setting (no name for it in the XBE).

fall height 1.label: Fall Height Tier 1
fall height 1.note: Drop (m) that costs fall damage 1 HP when you land (the graze).

fall damage 1.label: Fall Damage Tier 1
fall damage 1.note: HP lost landing from fall height 1 up to 2 (truncated to int32, 0x8AD87). Armor doesn't reduce it.

fall height 2.label: Fall Height Tier 2
fall height 2.note: Drop (m) that costs fall damage 2 HP instead (a hard landing).

fall damage 2.label: Fall Damage Tier 2
fall damage 2.note: HP lost landing from fall height 2 up to 3 (truncated to int32).

fall height 3.label: Fall Height Tier 3
fall height 3.note: Drop (m) that costs fall damage 3 HP; vanilla's 1000 kills (game over).

fall damage 3.label: Fall Damage Tier 3
fall damage 3.note: HP lost from fall height 3 up (truncated to int32). Reaching 0 HP is death and game over.

fall height 4.label: Fall Height Tier 4
fall height 4.note: Fall (m) past which a flap, a jump or a landing on no floor kills you, whatever your HP (game over). A landing on a floor uses heights 1-3.

fall min velocity.label: Fall Min Velocity
fall min velocity.note: Landing speed (m/s, vertical) below which heights 1-3 cost no HP.
